title: Year of The Dragon, 500 CFA francs

specs.Decoration: microprinting, digital printing, selective gilding, crystal

descriptionPlain: Description Continuation of the bestselling series – collect all the coins! Elegant decoration with ruthenium technique Gift idea expressing wishes for wealth and abundance The finest silver What will the Year of the Wooden Dragon bring? According to the Chinese horoscope, each of us will be powerfully influenced by this strong sign. The dragon is a symbol of power and energy, while wood brings qualities of development and growth. Numerologists say that material wealth will be a priority in 2024 – may this coin bring you all kinds of abundance!
